dependency_records.rationale: Earlier-stage evidence is a hard prerequisite for the later-stage capability.
Capabilities share a stage; preserve coordination without imposing an unproven order.

Approved documentation can be rendered into a validated distributable artifact.
Project context persistence may use an explicitly initialized local memory runtime.
